Long Beach Bicycling Meetup Wednesday Ride is a social group ride in Long Beach, CA. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Long Beach Windsurf Center. Pace: casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Long Beach Bicycling Meetup Wednesday Ride group ride

Casual evening ride toward Seal Beach or the Queen Mary and back, 60 to 90 minutes. Beach cruisers to mountain bikes all show up. Many riders stop for a drink afterward. About 1,400 members on Meetup.
